name: Orbital Decay
source:
The year is 2291. The research ship ESV Meridian orbits Veyra, an uncharted planet eleven months from home. At the heart of the story, three people. Alex, the ship’s engineer. His wife Nora, the botanist whose greenhouse makes the air they breathe. And Kane, the mechanic, followed by rumors from his last posting that Nora can’t forget.

Alex’s work keeps him alone in the reactor room at the stern, day after day, while Nora spends fourteen hours a day at the other end of the ship... with Kane. Between two repairs, Alex checks the ship’s cameras. They show him almost nothing. But Kane has cameras of his own: hidden lenses, put in one by one, where the ship’s cameras can’t see. Alex will never know they exist. You will see everything they see.
